metaTitle: Wi-Fi QR Generator: share your Wi-Fi with a QR code
metaDescription: Make a QR code that lets guests join your Wi-Fi. Export as PNG, PDF, DOCX or SVG. Free, private and works offline: nothing leaves your device.
clearHistoryBody: The saved codes and passwords on this device will be removed. This cannot be undone.
aboutIntro: Make a QR code that lets guests join your Wi-Fi by scanning it with a phone camera. It works for WPA/WPA2, WEP and open networks, including hidden ones.
aboutStep1: Enter the network name and choose the security type.
aboutStep2: Type the password. Open networks do not need one.
aboutStep3: Press Generate QR code, then print, download or share it.
aboutFaq1a: Yes. There is no account and nothing to pay.
aboutFaq2a: No. The code is made in your browser and nothing is sent to a server. Recent codes stay in this browser, and you can delete them at any time.
aboutFaq3a: Yes. Once the page has loaded you can install it and use it without a connection.
aboutFaq4a: PNG, PDF, DOCX and SVG. On phones that support it you can also share the PNG.
aboutLinks: Link options for developers and AI agents
